intro: The Step-In shoe cabinet helps you start every day on the right foot. Smart storage, built-in ventilation, & a compact design make it easy to keep shoes tidy while keeping your space clean & stylish.

features.title: Smart tiered design for easy organisation
features.text: Three well-placed tiers hold 9 to 12 pairs, making it easy to store, access, and organise your footwear without creating clutter in your entryway.

features.title: Ventilated shutters to keep shoes fresh
features.text: Angled shutters allow air circulation, reducing moisture buildup and preventing odours—so your shoes stay fresher for longer.

features.title: Open shelf for quick access
features.text: A convenient open shelf keeps your most-used shoes within easy reach, making busy mornings smoother and more organised.

features.title: Sturdy build for everyday use
features.text: Made from high-quality materials, our cabinet is built to withstand daily wear and tear, ensuring long-lasting durability.

features.title: Effortless maintenance for busy homes
features.text: Smooth, dust-resistant surfaces make cleaning quick and easy, ensuring your cabinet always looks neat with minimal effort.

features.title: Safety lock for secure storage
features.text: The cabinet comes with a robust safety lock, ensuring your prized footwear and accessories remain protected at all times.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
